request.promptText: Animate this Korean classroom teacher shot for the answer reveal. Keep the exact same teacher identity as the reference image: white-blue gradient hair, purple eyes, Korean traditional gat, black hanbok, black gloves. The teacher stands on the right side of the frame in front of the green chalkboard and makes a slow chalk-writing gesture toward the left side of the board, with a small confident nod. Motion should be natural and modest: soft arm movement, breathing, gentle camera push-in. Keep the chalkboard blank for later post-composited text. No readable text, no symbols, no subtitles, no watermarks, no strong yellow lighting or dramatic color changes.
